text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected for dedicated-pool-us-east-1 (tail latency). Paging @mike_oncall and oncall rotation. Root cause suspected: capacity warmup backlog / autoscaler lag.

mike_oncall: on it. I can see p95 ~ 480ms, p99 ~ 1.9s for text-generation (streaming). Streaming stall rate jumped ~ 7% in last 10m.

anna_eng: acknowledged, joining. Which tenants hit hardest?

mike_oncall: customers: finance-app-prod and assistant-x have the most errors — stream resets and timeouts. Queue depth for dedicated-pool-us-east-1 spike: 380 -> 1200 requests queued. Warmup queues show many model load ops pending.

infra_lead_julie: autoscaler logs show scale actions triggered 00:03:12 ago but new nodes not ready due to model prewarm step ~35-50s each. Autoscaler config currently targets pod count only, model loading happens post-scheduling.

eng_ops_tom: that's the issue: model cold-start + per-model warmup hook. We saw earlier 2025 tests where warmup took 20s; today the quantized variants take longer on this GPU image because kernel JIT hits.

mike_oncall: streaming stalls correlate with long model load times — many requests waiting for KV cache warmup. Also see token-generation stalls (logs below):
```
[2026-10-12T16:31:22Z] request_id=abc123 state=queued pool=dedicated-us-east-1 queue_pos=947
[2026-10-12T16:31:59Z] request_id=abc123 state=running model=redwood-7b variant=fp16 load_time=41.2s kv_warmup=true
[2026-10-12T16:32:02Z] request_id=abc123 state=streaming stall=true stall_reason=kv-cache-miss
```

cs_lead_sara: CS reporting several customer 502s, one high-touch finance customer is on call and very upset. Escalation underway, sending template note now.

anna_eng: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) manual scale up dedicated node count to drain queue, 2) enable emergency routing of new requests to hosted fallback model (same family, slightly higher cost), 3) reduce max concurrency per-pod to shorten per-request tail and allow faster warmup cycles. Thoughts?

infra_lead_julie: agree. I'll run manual scale now: `kubectl scale --replicas=+4 deployment/dedicated-pool-us-east-1` and trigger prewarm job for new nodes.

eng_ops_tom: I'll enable per-tenant throttling to prevent a single noisy tenant from consuming the warmup queue: `redwoodctl quotas set --tenant finance-app-prod --rps 5`

deploy_bot: :information_source: Manual scale triggered by julie at 2026-10-12T16:35:05Z. Prewarm job submitted: job/prewarm-models-20261012-163505.

mike_oncall: routing change: anna, can you flip the fallback route for new sessions to hosted-s-7b? Should cut cold-start time for new requests.

anna_eng: doing it now. `redwood-routing set --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --fallback hosted-s-7b --enable` -> applied. Will monitor.

mike_oncall: after manual scale and fallback enable, queue depth falling: 1200 -> 420 in 6m. p95 down to 210ms, p99 720ms. Streaming stalls down to ~1.3%.

cs_lead_sara: finance-app-prod reports reduced errors. They're still seeing occasional resets but MUCH better. Sending status update to customer now.

infra_lead_julie: note: autoscaler policy needs to account for model prewarm latency. Action item: add a warmup-weight to scaling decisions or add a prewarm replica buffer. I'll open a ticket.

eng_ops_tom: temp mitigation also included enabling quantized-variant fallback on dedicated pool. That reduced model load times for some requests.

mike_oncall: we should keep monitoring for 30m. If p99 stays <1s we'll transition to incident note -> postmortem. For now, on-call handoff in 25m to Anna (next rotation). Anna, you're aware?

anna_eng: I'm taking the handoff at 16:57 UTC. Will keep eyes on queue and routing.

mike_oncall: docs for runbook reference: `docs/incidents/dedicated-warmup.md` includes manual commands and fallback steps — follow that for playbook.

eng_ops_tom: adding follow-ups: (a) autoscaler warmup-aware policy, (b) prewarm job for common model variants on pool creation, (c) rate-limit per-tenant defaults, (d) improve telemetry to expose kv-cache-warm ratio.

cs_lead_sara: I'll follow up with affected customers and open SOC ticket for any billing/credits.

mike_oncall: closing page for now, we'll keep thread open for updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

anna_eng: update at 16:56 UTC — p99 at 650ms, stalls 0.9%. Keeping monitoring.

incident_bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT: mitigated (manual scaling + fallback routing). Severity reduction suggested. Please file postmortem and link in this thread when ready.

mike_oncall: filing postmortem draft and tagging infra and eng-ops for follow-up. Will include timeline, metrics, and action items.

anna_eng: adding a short checklist to the postmortem: reproduce locally with smaller model cache, simulate burst with `ab` + streaming clients, test prewarm hook improvements.

deploy_bot: :information_source: Prewarm job completed for 4 new nodes at 2026-10-12T16:41:12Z. Nodes ready and serving.

mike_oncall: final note: avoid routing all new sessions to hosted long-term — cost impact. Permanent fix needs warmup-aware autoscaling and model prewarm on scale events.

anna_eng: will own the postmortem and proposed remediation PRs.

cs_lead_sara: customer follow-up scheduled. Incident thread will be used for the postmortem link.

mike_oncall: thanks everyone. Handing off active watch to Anna. :wave:
